name: Learning & Study
description: Understand, memorise and practise any topic faster

prompts.title: Explain It Simply
prompts.description: Get a clear, jargon-free explanation with an analogy
prompts.content: Explain {{concept}} to {{audience}} in simple terms. Use one everyday analogy, avoid jargon, and finish with a one-sentence summary of why it matters.

examples.output: An API is like a restaurant waiter: you (an app) don't go into the kitchen (another system) yourself — you give the waiter a clear order, and they bring back exactly what you asked for. It lets two systems talk without needing to know how the other works inside. Why it matters: it's how the apps you use share data with each other.

prompts.title: Quiz Me
prompts.description: Generate practice questions with an answer key
prompts.content: Create {{count}} {{question_type}} questions about {{topic}} at a {{difficulty_level}} level. Number them, then provide an answer key at the end with a one-line explanation for each answer.

prompts.title: Make Flashcards
prompts.description: Turn study material into question/answer cards
prompts.content:
Turn the material below into {{count}} flashcards. Format each as "Q: ... / A: ...". Keep questions short and answers precise; cover the most important facts first.

{{material}}

variables.name: material
variables.description: The notes or text to study

prompts.title: Build a Study Plan
prompts.description: Get a realistic, milestone-based study schedule

variables.name: goal
variables.example: pass the AWS cloud practitioner exam

prompts.title: One-Page Revision Sheet
prompts.description: Condense material into a compact cheat sheet
prompts.content:
Condense the material below into a one-page revision sheet for {{topic}}. Use short headings, key definitions, formulas or rules, and the 5 things most likely to be tested. Keep it scannable.

{{material}}

prompts.title: Practice Problems
prompts.description: Generate exercises with fully worked solutions
prompts.content: Create {{count}} practice problems on {{topic}} at a {{difficulty_level}} level. After all the problems, give fully worked step-by-step solutions so I can check my reasoning, not just my answer.

prompts.title: Check My Understanding
prompts.description: Explain a concept in your own words and get gaps flagged

variables.name: my_explanation
variables.example: I think a vaccine puts a weak version of a germ in you so...

prompts.title: Compare & Contrast
prompts.description: Lay two things side by side on the criteria you care about
prompts.content: Compare {{item_a}} and {{item_b}} on these criteria: {{criteria}}. Present it as a table, then add a 2-sentence takeaway on when to choose each.
